In this tutorial, Devin builds a trend origin tracer. You paste a phrase like vibe coding, and it shows the earliest post it can find on X, who amplified it, and how it spread over time.
m01.png

Modal is what makes this possible. Anyone can open a public URL, paste a phrase, and get a trace, with no server to set up. Behind the page, Grok's X search, through the xAI API, finds the posts. Modal runs those searches in parallel.

Modal is what makes this possible. Anyone can open a public URL, paste a phrase, and get a trace, with no server to set up. Behind the page, Grok's X search, through the ex A I API, finds the posts. Modal runs those searches in parallel.
m02.png

Modal is what makes this possible. Anyone can open a public URL, paste a phrase, and get a trace, with no server to set up. Behind the page, Grok's X search, through the xAI API, finds the posts. Modal runs those searches in parallel.
